products.product_description: SHS Wel-Plan Wheat and Corn Strach Baking Mix , 400 g box,Cardboard carton, 18 cartons per case, but distributed by individual unit (carton).
products.code_info: Item code 105175, Lot code 2417 and UPC code 74973501-8644
products.reason_for_recall: Nutricia North America, Inc. has decided to recall SHS Wel-Plan Baking Mix , 400 g box because testing of the product has detected a low level (0.74 cfu/g) contamination of Klebsiella pneumonia. The product is a baking mix and is intended to be cooked, which would kill K. pneumonia. The recall is being conducted out of an abundance of caution to avoid the risk that some consumers may misuse the product and consume it without cooking.
